name: cal-val-data
title: Calibration and Validation Dataset
description: Model agnostic calibration and validation data. Tables mirror the workbook tabs and are generated by scripts/ingest.R, with stable text keys instead of database identifiers. Validation runs in warn mode (scripts/validate.R): known curation gaps warn, they do not fail. Date columns are kept as strings because current export mixes ISO, YYYYMMDD, and excel serial encodings; normalize on ingest.

licenses.name: BSD-3-Clause
licenses.title: code (scripts, tests) is BSD-3-Clause; curated data may carry CC-BY from upstream sources, cite data/citations.csv

fields.name: citation_id
fields.description: full citation text, or authorYYYYabc key (first letters of first three title words)

fields.name: doi
fields.description: DOI or URL; this is the join key used by observations.citation, managements.citation, and methods.citation_id

fields.name: name
fields.description: stable site key, one row per physical location; does not encode treatment, replicate, or date

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: decimal degrees

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: decimal degrees

fields.name: name
fields.description: stable treatment / system key, e.g. socs_sys1, compost, no_compost

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: treatment phase start; YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: treatment phase end

fields.name: control
fields.description: is this the baseline/control treatment

fields.name: pair_id
fields.description: pair identifier

fields.name: treatment_id_1
fields.description: baseline treatment by convention

fields.name: treatment_id_2
fields.description: comparison treatment

fields.name: comparison_factor
fields.description: e.g. compost, cover_crop_frequency, cover_crop_type, seeding_rate

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: unique row key, <mgmttype>-NNNN

fields.name: sites.name
fields.description: BETY-style dotted column name; foreign key to sites.name

fields.name: treatments.name
fields.description: foreign key to treatments.name; one treatment per row

fields.name: min_date
fields.description: event window start; YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

fields.name: max_date
fields.description: event window end; collapsed to a single date downstream

fields.name: mgmttype
fields.description: event type; a downstream consumer may map compost_application to fertilization

fields.name: cover_crop
fields.description: planting rows only: cover crop vs cash crop

fields.name: crop_name
fields.description: cover crop name on planting rows; cash crop identity lives in attributes_keyvalue crop=

fields.name: level
fields.description: rate / amount; always paired with units

fields.name: units
fields.description: closed vocabulary so downstream ud_convert can map it, e.g. Mg ha-1 (oven-dry), kg N ha-1, cm depth

fields.name: attributes_keyvalue
fields.description: semicolon-delimited key=value; key=value; carries material, N content, implement, timing, etc

fields.name: citation
fields.description: DOI; foreign key to citations.doi

fields.name: min_date
fields.description: earliest plausible date; mixed encodings in current export, ##TODO normalize

fields.name: max_date
fields.description: latest plausible date; equals min_date for point samples; blank when source gives no window

fields.name: sitename
fields.description: foreign key to sites.name

fields.name: variable
fields.description: foreign key to variables.name

fields.name: method
fields.description: links to methods; note current export uses depth-suffixed forms not present in methods

fields.name: value
fields.description: measured value in reported_units

fields.name: n
fields.description: sample size; 1 for replicate-level rows

fields.name: statname
fields.description: statistic name on summary rows, e.g. SE; blank for replicate rows

fields.name: stat
fields.description: statistic value; SD is not converted to SE during curation

fields.name: treatment_id
fields.description: foreign key to treatments.name

fields.name: replicate_id
fields.description: block / plot / core / chamber identifier

fields.name: study_year
fields.description: experiment year (White 0-8) or calendar year (Nichols 2019); mixed semantics

fields.name: min_depth
fields.description: cm; required for soil variables

fields.name: max_depth
fields.description: cm; required for SOC stock

fields.name: citation
fields.description: DOI; foreign key to citations.doi

fields.name: fill_status
fields.description: provenance / source-precedence code; blank allowed for now

fields.name: dataset_id
fields.description: short source-packet id, e.g. white_salinas_2020

fields.name: reported_units
fields.description: units as reported by the source

fields.name: observation_level
fields.description: experimental unit the row represents

fields.name: description
fields.description: must state dry vs wet basis and volumetric vs mass basis where relevant

fields.name: citation_id
fields.description: DOI of the method source; foreign key to citations.doi

fields.name: notes
fields.description: variety and per-crop management notes

resources.name: coverage
resources.description: coverage planning matrix: system and treatment contrast against each target, split into magnitude and treatment contrast. Workbook tab carries a multi row title preamble above header; ingest must skip preamble so these field names land on header row.
